name: Sear
description: Passive: Accursed's attacks apply Sear to enemies (Movement Slow) and grant Burning Strikes to attacking allies (Attack Speed + Move Speed). Active: Creates a Searing Flame on the ground dealing Magic Damage per turn and healing Accursed.

source.notes: From hon_reborn_slice.json. Passive: onattackimpact → applystate Sear (movespeedslow 5/10/15/20%, 2s) on enemy, Burning Strikes (attackspeed 10/20/30/40%, movespeedmultiplier 10%, 4.5s) on ally attackers. Active: self_position cast, spawns Gadget_Accursed_Ability3 (lifetime 4000ms) in radius 400 — area DoT 10/20/30/40 Magic/s + self-heal 8/12/16/20 + 0.4/0.6/0.8/1% max HP/s. Cooldown 24/22/20/18s. Mana 60.

adapted.adaptation_reason: Cooldown: ceil(24s / 5s) = 5 turns. Duration: ceil(4s / 5s) = 1 turn. Passive Sear: each attack applies Sear debuff (Slow, 1 turn). Passive Burning Strikes: ally attackers gain attack bonus next turn. Active: area hit all enemies in front row for 10*T=50 magic (T=5, level 1) + Accursed gains 8*T=40 HP + 0.4%*MaxHP HP. The active is an AoE zone effect collapsed into the turn. Balance risk: passive applies per attack making it very consistent — could be strong with high attack count units.
